title: The Smear Campaign
logline: A ruined merchant hires a pilot to steal a massive data core full of fabricated evidence before a corrupt journalist can broadcast it to the sector.

roles.description: Frantic, formerly wealthy, wearing ragged designer clothes.
Smug, well-dressed, entirely motivated by ratings and bribes.
A massive corporate media station covered in neon billboards.
A massive media monopoly that controls public opinion.

public_situation: The {role:news_syndicate} is teasing a massive exposé on the {role:ruined_merchant}, promising to reveal shocking crimes.
private_truth: The journalist fabricated the entire story at the behest of the merchant's corporate rivals to destroy their business.

beats.public_change: The journalist uploads the teaser trailer, sending the merchant's stock crashing.

missions.reason: The merchant begs the pilot to meet a corrupted archivist in the hub's loading bay and collect the master data core holding the evidence.
missions.private_fact: The core is massive and heavy, and it will fill most of the pilot's hold.

beats.public_change: The journalist discovers the theft and issues a system-wide bounty for the pilot.

missions.reason: The journalist hires the pilot (not realizing they are the thief) to deliver a backup drive from a secondary server.
missions.private_fact: The journalist accepted a lucrative private syndicate bribe to manufacture fake fraud allegations against the innocent merchant.

beats.public_change: Gravity tides spike, grounding most ships, but the journalist launches their broadcast drone anyway.

missions.reason: The merchant pays the pilot their last credits to deliver a localized EMP device to the hub's main antenna to stop the broadcast.
missions.private_fact: The EMP will destroy all data on the hub, including years of legitimate journalism.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot is ready to plant the EMP. The journalist is threatening to ruin the pilot's reputation next if they go through with it.

options.label: Plant the EMP and save the merchant
Walk away and let the broadcast happen

resolutions.summary: The fabricated story never airs. The merchant slowly rebuilds their business, and the journalist is fired for failing to deliver the scoop.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot destroyed a media drone to stop a fabricated smear campaign.

resolutions.summary: The story airs. The merchant is completely ruined and driven into exile. The journalist wins an award for investigative reporting.
The drone broadcasts the story across the system. The merchant is arrested by corporate security, and their assets are seized.

loose_threads.detail: The fabricated data was originally generated by a military psy-ops division, not just a rival company.
The journalist complains that they were forced to write the story because the syndicate is blackmailing them.

radio_hooks: Shocking exposé on {role:ruined_merchant} to air tonight.
{role:news_syndicate} promises the truth will shock the sector.
